claim_text: Historical CARE failures mainly reflect broken evidence chains, decoder/recipe inheritance gaps, and final-output component mismatch rather than one universally invalid idea.
Encoder-only inheritance plus reset decoder is insufficient to recover nnU-Net strength.
MoSAIC clean OOF and full-data recipe are different evidence regimes and must not be compared as clean architecture evidence.
Case-level oracle supports only modest direct gain over nnU-Net; voxel oracle is optimistic and not deployable by itself.
